# Triistic Global

> Triistic Global provides outsourced accounting and bookkeeping, accounts payable and receivable, FP&A and controller services for US businesses and CPA firms, delivered by a team led by Chartered Accountants.

Triistic Global works inside the client's own accounting system (for example QuickBooks, NetSuite or Xero).
Every entry is prepared and checked by Chartered Accountants, and for CPA firms the firm's own CPA does the
final review. Engagements start with a 30-day free trial. Contact: enquiry@triistic.com.

## Services

- [Outsourced bookkeeping and accounting](https://triistic.com/finance-accounting-outsourcing.html): bookkeeping, accounts payable and receivable, FP&A and management reporting, controller services
- [Outsourced accounting for CPA firms](https://triistic.com/outsourcing-for-cpa-firms.html): white-label capacity, CPA final review, tax-season scaling
- [AI-enabled finance](https://triistic.com/ai-enabled-finance.html): automated capture, coding and reconciliation with Chartered Accountant exception review
- [Business and financial advisory](https://triistic.com/advisory-consulting.html)
- [Business process outsourcing](https://triistic.com/business-process-outsourcing.html): payroll, HR, tax compliance and IT processes
